description: Hand-labelled career stories for evaluating services.extract. expected_skills are lower-case labels a careful human would extract; matching is done after normalisation, so labels do not have to be identical.

stories.story: I have taught secondary English for six years. I plan and rewrite the curriculum every term, run parent evenings, and present at staff training days. I also redesigned our department's intranet pages because nobody could find anything.

I run the night shift in a distribution centre. I track stock in spreadsheets, built a small Excel tool that flags slow-moving items, and cut picking errors by reorganising the aisles. I manage a team of twelve and report weekly numbers to the site manager.
I am a registered nurse on a busy medical ward. I triage patients, keep clinical notes up to date, and spent last year helping roll out a new electronic records system, training colleagues on it.

I have one year as a backend developer. I write Python services backed by Postgres, review pull requests, and wrote the test suite for our payment integration. I have used pandas for a couple of side projects but never trained a model.

I manage a small retail chain. I interview customers about what they want, set the monthly budget, schedule fifteen staff, and negotiate with suppliers. I introduced a loyalty scheme that grew repeat visits by a fifth.
